_README: Pilot: the full SLURM chain on the 18 runs in config/pilot_runs.txt (~37 GB).
Same chain and code as config_lrz.json, on 1 job x 2 nodes. logs/status.txt
should say COMPLETE, with BAMs in merged/bams/ and a matrix in
merged/counts/gene_counts.tsv. The download rate per run is the
download_mb_per_s column of merged/mapping_summary.tsv. See docs/SLURM.md.
_pilot_set: config/pilot_runs.txt: 16 strong-tier runs from different studies (to cover
different library protocols), 0.22-6.34 GB, plus 2 weak-tier runs (SRR10142815,
SRR4000640) that QC is expected to reject. The latter test that merge counts a
rejected run as finished. Strong-tier runs can be rejected by QC as well.

_slurm._: 1 job x 2 nodes = 224 cores. cm4_std takes at least 2 nodes per job.

project.name: ribomine-pilot
project._: 9 runs land on each node, so at most 9 of the 28 slots are in use.

pipeline._: start=accessions: prep splits accession_list (path relative to this file) instead of querying the archive.
